test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 08 Dec, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In 2025, which Ministry of Defence initiative aimed to modernise the armed forces in cyber, AI, and integrated command?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Year of Reforms**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• In **2025**, the **Ministry of Defence** launched an initiative called **Year of Reforms** aimed at modernising the armed forces.
 
• This initiative focused on integrating advanced technologies such as **cybersecurity**, **artificial intelligence (AI)**, and fostering **integrated command structures**.
 
• The goal was to create a robust defence mechanism to address emerging threats such as cyber warfare and AI-driven challenges.
 
• The initiative aimed to streamline operations, enhance inter-departmental coordination, and strengthen India's defence capabilities.
 
• **Year of Reforms** served as a cornerstone for transforming traditional military strategies into tech-driven, modern defence frameworks.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Cybersecurity in Defence:**

 
 
• Cybersecurity has become a critical aspect of national security due to the increasing threats of cyberattacks and data breaches.
 
• The initiative aimed to strengthen India's cyber defences through dedicated programmes, advanced monitoring systems, and skilled personnel.
 
• India's focus is on protecting critical infrastructure such as military databases, missile control systems, and communication networks from cyber threats.
 
• Cybersecurity advancements include the development of **firewalls, encryption technologies, and AI-based threat detection systems**.
 
 
 
• **Artificial Intelligence (AI) in Defence:**
 
 
• AI is revolutionising military strategies with applications in **autonomous drones, predictive analytics, and threat identification**.
 
• AI enables faster decision-making and real-time analysis of battlefield data.
 
• India's defence sector is exploring AI for applications such as robotic systems, surveillance, and intelligence-gathering.
 
• AI-based systems are being deployed to enhance precision in missile systems and target tracking.
 
 
 
• **Integrated Command Structures:**
 
 
• Integrated command structures aim to unify operations across different branches of the armed forces, including the **Army, Navy, and Air Force**.
 
• This approach enhances coordination, reduces operational redundancy, and enables a more coherent defence strategy.
 
• Joint commands allow seamless sharing of resources, intelligence, and personnel during critical operations.
 
• India has been working towards establishing integrated theatre commands to address regional security challenges effectively.
 
 
 
• **Modernisation of Armed Forces:**
 
 
• Modernisation efforts include the procurement of advanced weaponry, upgrading existing systems, and adopting new technologies.
 
• India's defence budget has been increasingly allocated to research and development in cutting-edge technologies.
 
• Focus areas include **missile defence systems, space warfare capabilities, and advanced combat platforms**.
 
• Modernisation ensures that the armed forces remain prepared to counter both conventional and unconventional threats.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Digital India and Defence:** While **Digital India** is a major government programme aimed at transforming India into a digitally empowered society, its scope is broader and not specific to defence modernisation.
 
• **Make in India:** This initiative focuses on boosting indigenous manufacturing, including defence production, but does not directly address cyber, AI, or integrated command structures.
 
• **Operation Cold Start:** A military doctrine aimed at rapid mobilisation and limited warfare, but unrelated to technological modernisation in cyber and AI.
 
• **Year of Reforms:** Specifically targets modernising India's armed forces, making it the correct answer for initiatives related to cyber, AI, and integrated command.
